    - complementary:
      - heading "EXPLODED VIEW" [level=3]
      - text: Cylinder Hemisphere
      - heading "LIVE RESULTS" [level=2]
      - text: Volume (V) 90π cm³ ≈ 282.74 cm³ External Surface Area (TSA) 75π cm² ≈ 235.62 cm²
    - heading "FORMULA LEDGER" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "Volume (add all components)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: V = Σ component volumes
      - paragraph: "Cylinder: πr²h Cone: ⅓πr²h Hemisphere: ⅔πr³"
      - strong: V = 90π cm³ ≈ 282.74 cm³
    - article:
      - heading "External Surface Area (exclude joined faces)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: TSA = Σ full surfaces − 2πr² per join
      - paragraph: 2 components create 1 joined face(s).
      - strong: TSA = 75π cm² ≈ 235.62 cm²
    - complementary:
      - heading "What's excluded?" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Shared circular faces between joined components are internal and not counted.
    - article:
      - heading "2 WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Add volumes because space combines.
      - paragraph: Exclude joined faces from TSA because they are hidden inside.
      - text: Joined face (internal) not counted in TSA.
    - article:
      - heading "3 WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Cylinder (r=3 cm, h=8 cm) + Hemisphere (r=3 cm)
      - paragraph: Volume V = π(3²)(8) + ⅔π(3³) = 90π cm³
      - paragraph: External Surface Area TSA = 2πrh + πr² + 2πr² = 75π cm²
    - article:
      - heading "4 COMMON MISTAKE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Counting the shared circular face overstates TSA.
      - paragraph: "Wrong: includes internal face."
      - paragraph: "Correct: subtract both copies of every joined face."
